correctness.rationale: Complete finite enumeration: 24 Hamiltonian-cycle facets independently match complements of all 24 perfect matchings; all 252,902 nonempty faces generated; 126,450 disjoint covering pairs, one critical 0-face and one critical dimension-7 face, and 1,936,998 directed Hasse incidences all consumed by a complete topological sort. Standard discrete Morse theory yields a CW model with one 0-cell and one 7-cell, necessarily S^7. Standalone checker included, executed and output checked; no extrapolation beyond this finite graph.

value.rationale: The graph is the canonical Fano-plane incidence (Heawood) graph with exactly 24 Hamiltonian cycles. The natural simplicial down-closure of Hamiltonian edge sets probes the topological structure of edge extension to spanning cycles and is distinct from familiar matching complexes. Its pure 13-dimensional facets collapse homotopically to one 7-sphere, a strong structural invariant not implied by counting cycles, ordinary matching data, or rational Betti computations. The full simple homotopy certificate supplies a meaningful case benchmark for Hamiltonian-facet topology.
